title: H357 stub: Multi-modal earnings direction prediction on PEAD universe
rationale: Two complementary 2025-2026 papers upgrade the PEAD signal stack beyond our H174 FinBERT baseline. arXiv:2509.24254 (Wu et al.): 138k earnings press releases 2005-2023, BERT-based structured extraction of press release sections (headline, summary, guidance) — shows 'soft information' (text structure) is as informative as EPS surprise 'hard information'. arXiv:2605.25894 (Noseda et al.): multi-modal deep learning combining pre-announcement news sentiment + firm fundamentals + recent market dynamics (30 days prior) to predict EA-day direction (UP/DOWN/NEUTRAL). Key insight from 2605.25894: pre-announcement signals in the 30-day window before EA carry significant directional information that is distinct from the EA-day 8-K content we currently use. Current H174 only uses 8-K text + EPS surprise at announcement. H357 adds: (1) structured press release section parsing per 2509.24254, (2) 30-day pre-announcement sentiment composite per 2605.25894. Expected: higher precision on UP direction (fewer false positives), better NEUTRAL filtering.
